# [maintenance] Brake pad and rotor replacement tips

## Summary

[Partial] Soak the front driver side brake caliper in vinegar and remove rust from the bracket and pads. [t498]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Soak the front driver side brake caliper in vinegar to reduce rust buildup.
2. Remove accumulated rust from the caliper bracket and pads using a short mill bastard file.

_Procedure reported by [t498]._

## Tools

- Short mill bastard files [t498]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Avoid drilled rotors as they may be less desirable for off-roaders compared to slotted ones. [t498]
- [Partial] Clean slotted rotors thoroughly if using them, or avoid drilling entirely. [t498]
